profile.headline: Software Engineer at Matterport
profile.summary: Full stack developer with over 10 years of experience. Worked with many different tools, languages, environments.  Certified scrum developer.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Full stack developer. Developed and maintained multiple back end systems using Kotlin and Python (with Django) and front end using AngularJs and Angular. Worked with a large team with geographically diverse members. Developed epics and stories for new features and oversaw the completion of the work.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop software products to support bio-medical devices.  Research and development on computer vision and machine learning approaches.

positions.title: Assistant Professor
positions.description: Taught upper level undergraduate courses in operating systems, computer graphics, artificial intelligence and others.

positions.title: GRA
positions.description: Research using autonomous rover to measure ice sheet thickness.
